Drag orbits, wheel zooms, space plays, arrows scrub, keys 1 to 7 set speed, c changes the camera. Road picks the course the others are matched onto. Sync switches the same clock for the same distance; Matched start runs the chapters every rider shares, each one from a standing start together. Click a road marker to reopen its card. Auto camera frames all riders when they are close and follows the reference rider when they spread out, with an arrow at the edge for a rider out of view; Overview shows the whole course at once. The inset map keeps the whole course in view in every camera mode.
